text:
maya: Prod gateway latency + 5xx spike across inference routes, starting ~2287654300. Seeing steady increase in single-client qps that overwhelms small pods. Propose temporary 'surge-throttle' routing policy to soft-shunt heavy clients and avoid full failovers.

tariq: +1, can you paste the minimal policy? we need something reversible and telemetry-gated.

maya: sketch below — inject header and reduce weight to a low-capacity bucket. This avoids bouncing all traffic to standby.

```yaml
route_match: '/v1/generate*'
condition: 'client.qps > 200'
actions:
  - set_header: { 'X-RD-Surge-Throttle': '1' }
  - route_weight: { 'surge_bucket': 0.05, 'primary': 0.95 }
telemetry: 
  metrics: ['5xx_rate', 'p95_latency']
  alert_on: '5xx_rate > 1%'
```

leo: fwiw prefer weight change + header so downstream runtime can opt-out of heavy ops. also we should track hashed-candidate ids so we don't shard kv-cache too poorly.

ash: agree. add a TTL on the rule (10m) and an auto-revert if 5xx normalizes. we should also flip a feature-flag instead of direct config so console shows it.

maya: updated plan: schedule feature-flag `surge_throttle_active` at org-level, gate via console toggle and an api-gw quick-toggle. TTL 15m, auto-revert at 3 consecutive 1-min windows below threshold.

opsbot: deploy-bot: rolling config update queued for gateway cluster 'us-west-1' (change id: cfg-2287654321). ETA ~2m.

tariq: quick checklist before toggle: 1) add doc snippet in console runbook 2) create temp dashboard with tagged telemetry 3) notify cust-success for high-traffic customers 4) pre-create rollback cmd.

maya: checklist done. pre-rollback commands:
```bash
# rollback to previous weights
rdctl gateway apply --cluster us-west-1 --change cfg-2287654321 --rollback
# or disable feature flag
rdctl ff set org.surge_throttle_active false
```

leo: also make sure the header strip rule for internal services is in place so we don't leak `X-RD-Surge-Throttle` to downstream vendors. add: `strip_headers: [ 'X-RD-Surge-Throttle' ]` on egress.

deploy-bot: config cfg-2287654321 applied to 3/3 gateways in us-west-1 in 42s.

maya: toggled `surge_throttle_active=true` via console. watch dashboard: https://console.redwood/telemetry/gateway?tag=cfg-2287654321

ash: seeing immediate drop in p95 from 720ms -> 305ms on affected routes. 5xx still elevated but trending down. keeping TTL at 15m.

tariq: if 5xx drops below 0.5% for 3m, we auto-revert? confirm.

maya: auto-revert condition = 3 consecutive 1-min windows with 5xx < 0.5%. enabled.

opsbot: alert: auto-revert triggered at 2287654377. beginning rollback sequence.

deploy-bot: rollback cfg-2287654321 executed, gates restored to original weights.

maya: Closing notes: - Save the console audit link to the incident thread - Follow-up: propose a permanent surge-throttle policy with per-customer rate limits + telemetry knobs so we can avoid manual toggles next time. :thumbsup:

leo: +1. Add to eng-platform backlog and assign owner.
